summary: Frontend-only validation of two just-landed changes. BOTH features PASS. (1) Boom-Garden tap-cue (data-testid='boom-tap-cue'): confirmed to mount during the kid INPUT phase in BOTH 'copy' (Parrot Percussion) and 'trail' (Rhythm Run) modes, and NOT in 'match' (Beat Finder) mode. (2) Beat Lab mute buttons: all data-testid='mute-<trackId>' buttons remain inside their label-column parent on 375x812 mobile viewport, the page has no horizontal overflow, long preset-added labels (Scratch Pull / Scratch Push after DJ Scratch preset) truncate with CSS ellipsis (scrollWidth 83/88px > clientWidth 54px) and do NOT spill into the step grid. Mute click toggles mute state (row class updates).

boom_copy_mode.note: Cue only observed when body text contained 'Your turn / play it on the snare'. During Listen and Count-in phases cue was absent (0).

boom_trail_mode.note: Trail mode UI uses 'Read & play as each note hits the line' + 'TAP STEW!' CTA rather than 'Your turn' text, so my input-phase regex didn't match, but 'TAP HERE' badge visible in screenshot and 331 cue mounts confirm the pulse ring fires once per playable note during the input run.

boom_match_mode.note: Confirmed cue does NOT appear in Beat Finder (match) mode, as expected.

console_warnings_noted: React duplicate key error from an upstream render (observed on both Beat Lab and Boom-Garden routes). Likely from a shared component (also flagged in iteration_23). Not caused by the two features under test but still worth fixing.
AudioContext autoplay warning (expected until user gesture).
AnimatePresence mode='wait' with multiple children warning.
action_items: Investigate pre-existing React 'duplicate key' console error (also observed in prior iteration 23). Not blocking the two features but keeps appearing.
critical_code_review_comments: scheduleVisualPlayhead correctly suppresses tap-cue in 'match' mode and only pulses on non-rest notes (verified empirically: 0 cues in match mode, exactly input-phase cues in copy mode).
LoopStudioPage mute button w-full min-w-0 + truncate wrapper fix works on 375px wide viewport; preset-added long labels truncate correctly.
seed_data_creation: localStorage.jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1' to bypass onboarding modal during automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both frontend changes verified. For automation: set localStorage jma_player_name_skipped_v1=1 then click body once to clear audio-unlock overlay. On #/boom-garden the mode cards expose data-testid boom-mode-copy / boom-mode-match / boom-mode-trail; always dismiss the 'HOW TO PLAY' overlay with get_by_role('button', name='Got it'). Trail mode UI does NOT use the 'Your turn' input-phase text — use 'TAP HERE' badge or just presence of boom-tap-cue during the run.
